caption: Day 4 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍽️ Ingredients: • 1 chicken breast • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp oregano • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp paprika • ½ tsp mustard • Juice of ½ lemon • 2 tbsp butter • ½ small onion • 3 garlic cloves • 2 handfuls mushrooms • 2 handfuls cherry tomatoes • 1 handful baby spinach • ½ cup heavy cream • Parmesan (optional) Directions: Slice and season the chicken → cook until golden → sauté onion, garlic, mushrooms, tomatoes, and spinach → stir in heavy cream → return the chicken to the pan → finish with Parmesan ✨ Serve over pasta, rice, or roasted veggies 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #tuscanchicken #whatmytoddlereats #toddlermeals #toddlerrecipes
